title: SFL-Net: Dependence-Regularized Latent Pathways for Multi-Contrast MRI-to-tau-PET Synthesis and Component Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2602.22545v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Structural MRI-to-tau-PET synthesis estimates molecular imaging patterns from indirect anatomical correlates. We present SFL-Net, a vector-quantized architecture with shared, T1-specific, FLAIR-specific, and joint-input latent pathways. Dependence regularization differentiates these pathways, while latent-derived structural conditioning supports decoding without direct encoder-decoder feature skips. We evaluated SFL-Net and capacity-matched VAE, VQ-VAE, U-Net, and SPADE-U-Net variants using 605 training and 83 internal validation subjects pooled from ADNI-3 and OASIS-3. SFL-Net achieved the lowest raw PET MAE and MSE and the highest PSNR among the implemented models, while SPADE-U-Net variants performed better on several SUVR and staging metrics. translated_title: SFL-Net：用于多对比度MRI到tau-PET合成与成分归因的依赖正则化潜在通路
translated_abstract: 结构MRI到tau-PET的合成旨在从间接的解剖学相关特征中估计分子成像模式。我们提出了SFL-Net，这是一种向量量化架构，包含共享、T1特异性、FLAIR特异性以及联合输入四种潜在通路。依赖正则化用于区分这些通路，而源自潜在空间的结构条件化支持解码过程，无需直接的编码器-解码器特征跳跃连接。我们使用从ADNI-3和OASIS-3汇总的605名训练受试者和83名内部验证受试者，评估了SFL-Net以及容量匹配的VAE、VQ-VAE、U-Net和SPADE-U-Net变体。在所实现的模型中，SFL-Net取得了最低的原始PET MAE和MSE以及最高的PSNR，而SPADE-U-Net变体在若干SUVR和分期指标上表现更佳。精确的联盟Shapley归因分析表明，联合输入通路具有最大的平均边际贡献，且在不同受试者之间存在显著差异。
tldr: SFL-Net通过依赖正则化区分共享、T1特异、FLAIR特异和联合输入四种潜在通路，实现多对比度MRI到tau-PET的合成，在原始PET误差指标上达到最优，并通过精确Shapley归因揭示联合输入通路贡献最大且个体差异显著。
en_tdlr: SFL-Net, a vector-quantized architecture with dependence-regularized shared, T1-specific, FLAIR-specific, and joint-input latent pathways, achieves state-of-the-art raw PET synthesis metrics for multi-contrast MRI-to-tau-PET translation, with exact coalitional Shapley attribution revealing the joint-input pathway's dominant and subject-varying contribution.
